prompt: In the ideal isolated output-stationary model, a two-by-two array computes one two-by-two matrix product in four cycles. It performs eight useful MAC operations across sixteen available processing-element cycles. What is its average utilisation?

options.explanation: Eight of sixteen available processing-element cycles do useful MAC work.
Reusing operands does not remove the fill and drain intervals where some processing elements are idle.
This counts only four useful operations; the two-by-two product has eight MAC operations.
One third is the large-square-size limiting utilisation in this isolated schedule, not the two-by-two result.

workedExample: Count four processing elements over four cycles: sixteen available element-cycles. The product has four outputs with two MAC operations each, giving eight useful element-cycles. Eight divided by sixteen is one half, or 50%. This model excludes stalls and does not describe an overlapped stream of products.
